$comment: Fleet-owned frozen validation slice of the Kargo v1.9.10 ProjectConfig CRD (charts/kargo/resources/crds/kargo.akuity.io_projectconfigs.yaml, module github.com/akuity/kargo v1.9.10). Like the Warehouse slice, this validates the shapes THIS chart renders, not every shape upstream accepts — hence the closed spec. ProjectConfig is the CR that actually gates promotion, so it is validated rather than skipped: `gate: manual` is realized as the ABSENCE of an enabling policy, and an unvalidated render could lose that distinction silently.

promotionPolicies.$comment: May legitimately be EMPTY: a platform whose every stage is gate: manual enables nothing. An empty list is meaningfully different from a missing key, so the key is required while the array is not.

stageSelector.$comment: The chart selects by exact Stage name. Upstream also permits matchLabels/matchExpressions; those are deliberately excluded so a selector cannot silently widen to match Stages the pipeline never declared.

autoPromotionEnabled.$comment: Only `true` is ever rendered. A policy entry exists to ENABLE auto-promotion; a `false` entry would be an inert row that reads like a deliberate opt-out and blurs the absence-means-manual rule.
